player_prompt.intro:
O tla bona {N} dipelo tse tsietswang go ya go tsenyana.
Ka teng mo go ngwanelwa, o ngwale [accept] go kgetha *tseo di bonwang* tse di leng kwa ntle, kgotsa [continue] go di tsenyetsa tsena tse di bonwang.
Ufe o sa ame, o tla kgetha tseo di bonwang pele.
O fitlha (reward = 1) **fela** fa o kgethile tseo di bonwang di kgone go feta

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kgato e tshwanetse go nna [accept] kgotsa [continue].

outcome.summary: O amile tseno {value} mo drawing {draw_num}/{N}. Efe ya tsone kwa ntle e ne e le {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: Ke tshwetso e e molemo tota!
outcome.not_max: Ga se gore ke a bo a le kwa godimo.
